links.label: APRSdos
links.description: A DOS/Win3.x application with rudimentary maps. This is where it all started.

links.label: APRSdroid
links.description: An APRS application for Android smartphones — excellent.

links.label: APRSpro
links.description: An APRS application for iOS smartphones.

links.label: APRS.fi

links.label: Findu.com
links.description: Along with APRS.fi, the web face of APRS — look up any APRS station on a map.

links.label: APRS Applications Compared

links.description: Connect a weather station directly to the network and submit WX data via CWOP.

links.label: APRS via Satellites
links.description: Several satellites are configured for APRS digipeating.

links.label: Australia APRS Site
links.description: A great website with lots of resources.

links.label: WB4APR APRS Site
links.description: Bob Bruninga, WB4APR — known as "Father Bob," the creator of APRS.

links.label: W3PGA APRS Site
links.description: Another great resource for APRS.

links.label: YouTube
links.description: A list of videos related to APRS and NWAPRS.

links.description: Send Red Cross health and welfare messages via e-mail.

links.label: TNC-X
